SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
No. S. B. D.
Date

June 18, 1940.

Commissioner General,

Letter from German Consul General.
Your endorsement - June 12, 1940.

Special Branch have warned all papers concerned
against alarmists' stories of "fifth column" activities.
Every effort will be continued to keep such disturbing
news items out of the press as far as possible.

One difficulty is the propaganda matter included
in the English edition of the Ostasiatischer Lloyd, and
the other main obstruction is the Broadcasts of the Trans-
ocean News Service & Commentary. The latter has become
very much more violent of late; an example of the Broad-
cast on June 17 is attached.

In such an atmosphere, it is difficult to justify
action of a direct nature against American Papers fully
registered or otherwise.

I do not know if a further talk between yourself
and the German Consul General would be helpful. This
type of propaganda snowballs into trouble of quite serious
proportions, and unless some compromise can be arrived at,
to include both sides, I feel the Police can only take
official action in the case of articles or broadcasts

上海公共租界工部局警务处
编号 S. B. D.
日期

1940年6月18日。

总巡捕房总监，

德国总领事来函。
阁下批注 - 1940年6月12日。

特别处已警告所有相关报刊，不得刊登关于“第五纵队”活动的危言耸听报道。我们将继续尽一切努力，尽可能防止此类令人不安的新闻见诸报端。

一个困难在于《东亚劳埃德日报》（Ostasiatischer Lloyd）英文版中包含的宣传内容，另一个主要障碍是跨洋新闻服务及评论（Trans-ocean News Service & Commentary）的广播。后者近来变得愈发激烈；附上6月17日广播的一个实例。

在这种氛围下，很难证明对完全注册或以其他方式登记的美国报纸采取直接行动是正当的。

我不清楚您与德国总领事是否需要进行进一步会谈。此类宣传如滚雪球般演变成相当严重的麻烦，除非能达成某种兼顾双方的妥协，否则我认为警方只能针对那些旨在直接煽动破坏和平的文章或广播采取官方行动

档案
